exams.name: HDI Customer Service Representative
exams.blurb: Entry-level HDI certification on customer service fundamentals, communication skills, problem solving and handling difficult support interactions.

exams.name: HDI Desktop Advanced Support Technician
exams.blurb: HDI certification for desktop and field support staff covering onsite troubleshooting, asset handling, escalation and customer interaction skills.

exams.name: HDI Support Center Analyst
exams.blurb: Service desk certification covering incident handling, customer service skills, communication techniques and support centre processes and metrics.

exams.name: HDI Support Center Manager
exams.blurb: HDI management certification covering support strategy, service level agreements, budgeting, staffing, metrics and continuous service improvement.

exams.name: HDI Support Center Team Lead
exams.blurb: HDI certification for support team leaders covering coaching, workflow management, performance monitoring, quality assurance and team communication.

exams.name: PCAP - Certified Associate in Python Programming
exams.blurb: Associate Python Institute exam covering modules, packages, exceptions, strings, object-oriented programming, generators and file processing.

exams.name: PCED - Certified Entry-Level Data Analyst with Python
exams.blurb: Python Institute exam covering data acquisition, cleaning, analysis and visualisation in Python for people entering data analyst roles.

exams.name: PCEP - Certified Entry-Level Python Programmer
exams.blurb: Entry-level Python Institute exam covering syntax, data types, control flow, functions, lists and basic error handling in Python.

exams.name: PCPP1 - Certified Professional in Python Programming 1
exams.blurb: Professional Python exam covering advanced object-oriented programming, GUI development with tkinter, file formats, network programming and testing.

exams.name: PCPP2 - Certified Professional in Python Programming 2
exams.blurb: Advanced Python Institute exam covering design patterns, interprocess communication, Python-SQL databases, client-server work and testing principles.

exams.name: Fortinet Certified Associate in Cybersecurity
exams.blurb: Entry-level Fortinet certification covering threat landscape awareness, security fundamentals and an introduction to the Fortinet Security Fabric.

exams.name: Fortinet Certified Expert
exams.blurb: Top Fortinet credential requiring a hands-on lab exam on designing and troubleshooting complex enterprise Fortinet security deployments.

exams.name: Fortinet Certified Professional in Network Security
exams.blurb: Professional Fortinet certification on FortiGate administration, security profiles, SD-WAN, VPNs and integration across the Security Fabric.

exams.name: Fortinet Certified Solution Specialist
exams.blurb: Advanced Fortinet certification with tracks in network security, security operations, public cloud security and secure access service edge.

exams.name: ArchiMate 3 Foundation
exams.blurb: Open Group certification covering the ArchiMate modelling language, its layers, elements, relationships and viewpoints for enterprise architecture.

exams.name: ArchiMate 3 Practitioner
exams.blurb: Scenario-based Open Group exam on applying ArchiMate viewpoints, motivation and implementation extensions to model real architecture problems.

exams.name: TOGAF Enterprise Architecture Foundation
exams.blurb: Part 1 examination of The Open Group TOGAF Standard, covering enterprise architecture terminology, the ADM cycle, governance and content framework.

exams.name: TOGAF Enterprise Architecture Practitioner
exams.blurb: Scenario-based Part 2 examination requiring candidates to apply the TOGAF ADM, stakeholder management and architecture techniques to case studies.

exams.name: Oracle Certified Foundations Associate: Java
exams.blurb: Entry-level Oracle exam covering Java basics such as data types, control flow, arrays, methods, classes and object-oriented programming concepts.

exams.name: Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE 11 Developer
exams.blurb: Oracle professional Java SE 11 exam covering core language features, modules, streams, concurrency and secure coding; superseded by later versions.

exams.name: Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE 17 Developer
exams.blurb: Oracle professional exam covering Java SE 17 language features, generics, collections, streams, concurrency, modules and exception handling.

exams.name: Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE 21 Developer
exams.blurb: Oracle professional exam on Java SE 21 covering records, sealed classes, pattern matching, virtual threads, streams and the module system.

exams.name: HPE Aruba Networking Certified Associate - Campus Access
exams.blurb: Associate certification covering Aruba campus switching and wireless deployment, WLAN configuration, Layer 2 and 3 services and basic security.

exams.name: HPE Aruba Networking Certified Expert - Campus Access
exams.blurb: Expert-level Aruba credential requiring a hands-on lab exam on designing, deploying and troubleshooting complex campus wired and wireless networks.

exams.name: HPE Aruba Networking Certified Professional - Campus Access
exams.blurb: Professional certification covering advanced Aruba campus design, redundancy, AOS-CX features, roaming, tunnelled nodes and network optimisation.

exams.name: ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor
exams.blurb: Credential for professionals leading information security management system audits against ISO/IEC 27001, covering audit planning and reporting.

exams.name: ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer
exams.blurb: Credential for professionals establishing and operating an ISO/IEC 27001 information security management system including risk treatment and controls.

exams.name: ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Auditor
exams.blurb: Credential for auditing artificial intelligence management systems against ISO/IEC 42001, covering AI governance, risk and impact assessment.

exams.name: CIW Advanced HTML5 and CSS3 Specialist
exams.blurb: CIW certification covering semantic HTML5 markup, responsive CSS3 layout, forms, media elements, accessibility and cross-browser development.

exams.name: CIW JavaScript Specialist
exams.blurb: CIW certification covering JavaScript syntax, the document object model, event handling, form validation, AJAX and client-side scripting practice.

exams.name: CIW Web Foundations Associate
exams.blurb: Entry-level CIW certification covering internet fundamentals, web browsers, networking basics and introductory web page authoring concepts.

exams.name: CLA - C Programming Language Certified Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on the C programming language covering pointers, arrays, structures, memory management, the preprocessor and standard library use.

exams.name: CPA - C++ Certified Associate Programmer
exams.blurb: Associate C++ Institute exam covering C++ syntax, data types, control structures, functions, classes, inheritance and basic exception handling.

exams.name: CPP - C++ Certified Professional Programmer
exams.blurb: Professional C++ Institute exam covering templates, the standard template library, smart pointers, move semantics and advanced object-oriented design.

exams.name: Check Point Certified Security Administrator
exams.blurb: Administrator certification on Check Point security gateways and management servers, covering policy, NAT, identity awareness, logging and monitoring.

exams.name: Check Point Certified Security Expert
exams.blurb: Expert-level Check Point certification covering advanced policy management, clustering, VPN troubleshooting, acceleration and upgrade procedures.

exams.name: F5 Certified BIG-IP Administrator
exams.blurb: F5 credential earned by passing the 101 Application Delivery Fundamentals and 201 TMOS Administration exams covering BIG-IP operation and support.

exams.name: F5 Certified Technology Specialist, Local Traffic Manager
exams.blurb: F5 specialist credential requiring the 301a and 301b exams on architecting, maintaining and troubleshooting BIG-IP Local Traffic Manager deployments.
